messages:
ops-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-04-05T09:13:09Z — Elevated 500/503 responses observed from eu-west cache-layer affecting hosted generation endpoints that use prefix KV caching. Automatic fallback to uncached path enabled. Status: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1723456789 :warning:

Nadia (oncall): Investigating. Grafana shows sharp rise in cache eviction latency and a correlated surge in disk I/O on the cache nodes. Initiating read-only routing to reduce pressure and starting a rolling restart of the cache pool.

Ravi (eng-sre): Logs show repeated "evict_failed: slab_exhausted" plus a few tracebacks from the cache worker. Snippet:
```
[09:11:55] cache.worker: evict_failed: slab_exhausted
[09:12:02] cache.worker: retry eviction (attempt 3)
[09:12:10] kernel: oom_reaper invoked
```

Jules (support): Drafting a short message for affected customers — keeping it clear: fallback activated, requests still succeed but with increased latency. Will send to priority customers now and post in #support-updates.

Marisol (product): Please confirm whether Dedicated/Dedicated-Private customers are affected so we don't blur messaging.

Nadia (oncall): Dedicated/private unaffected; problem limited to the shared eu-west cache tier. Fallback preserves correctness.

Tao (infra): Temporarily increasing eviction headroom and switching some nodes to larger instance types to relieve IO. Provisioning ETA ~4m. Also collecting heap dumps and node metadata for post-incident analysis. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1723456789/

ops-bot: Update 09:19Z — read-only routing in place, additional instances added. Error rate down from 5.4% -> 1.2%. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv-cache/eu-west?orgId=1

Ravi (eng-sre): After scaling, eviction spikes reduced but there are still intermittent 503s tied to a specific replica set. Isolating bad nodes for remediation.

Jules (support): Sent customer note to Tier 1 list. Template included next steps and link to status page.

Nadia (oncall): Isolation complete; draining two misbehaving replicas. Monitoring for 10m to ensure error rate continues to decline. Postmortem leads: Ravi, Tao.

Marisol (product): Thanks — I'll prepare a concise external summary once we hit stable. No need for public advisory until we confirm TTL for stabilization.

ops-bot: Update 09:31Z — error rate 0.08% over last 10m, tail latency returned to baseline. Criteria met for incident close. Final note: no data loss, fallbacks were successful, customers notified. :white_check_mark:
